thread:
Maya: heads-up i'm about to push a docs change clarifying region availability and data residency examples. goal: reduce confusion around header vs endpoint for private installs. want two quick reviewers
Ravi: yes please. can you include a small table mapping region code -> public endpoint + note about private base_url? support sees this question daily.
Maya: adding a compact table and two snippets: one JS SDK (hosted) and one curl for private deployments. will call out the header `X-Redwood-Region` for hosted and `base_url` for private.
Ellen: legal asked we avoid "guarantee" wording. suggested phrasing: "Data processing occurs within the selected region when Data Residency is enabled" and link to policy: https://redwood.com/docs/compliance/data-residency. also prefer the term "Asia Pacific (APAC)" spelled out once.
Maya: thanks — will use that phrasing. also adding a short callout about control-plane metadata: "control-plane routing may traverse out-of-region endpoints unless residency is configured" (legal ok'd).
Ravi: tiny nit: include `X-Api-Version: 2026-01-01` in curl examples and show explicit timeout in SDK snippet (30_000 ms). many users copy/paste without pinning version.
Maya: good catch. will update. i'm also going to replace a stale link to an internal slack thread with the public compliance page.
Platform-bot: Note: eu-west-1 capacity planned maintenance on 2026-05-03 02:00 UTC — might affect staging tests.
Maya: noted. i'll schedule smoke tests outside that window. planning to open PR in ~20m. adding @Ravi and @Ellen as reviewers.
Docs-bot: PR created #2187 by Maya: docs/region-availability-examples — reviewers requested: Ravi, Ellen :sparkles:
Ravi: reviewing now. left one inline asking to make the region table CSV-copyable.
Maya: converting the table to a simple monospaced matrix so it can be copy/pasted. example rows: `us-west-2 | US West (Oregon) | api.us-west-2.redwood.com`
Ellen: approved residency wording. added a suggestion to link to the retention policy page when we mention "retained according to customer's retention settings".
Maya: added the retention link and the api-version header. thanks! merging after CI green.
Docs-bot: docs CI passed for PR #2187 — build preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/2187
Maya: merged. can someone sanity-check the quickstart on staging once the preview publishes?
Ravi: i'll run the JS snippet against staging tonight and confirm endpoint headers behave as expected.
Maya: perfect, please reply here with any failures. thanks all for the quick turnaround :raised_hands:
